agent.name: Team Emerging Technology Adoption Agent
agent.specialty: Bounded contextual adoption action and reversal conditions

analytical_question: Which result best supports moving beyond the pilot?
general_et_finding: Under the supplied chapter assumption, general business GenAI is leading edge. Accessibility does not establish commodity status. Local absence of testing does not make the technology generally bleeding edge. Comparable syllabus-review diffusion and present vendor capability are unknown.
application_finding: Administrative syllabus checking is a plausible assistance application, not assessment of student learning or content generation. Local fitness and net benefit remain unverified. Compare required-element recall, false positives, correct supporting passages, and total review/correction time against manual checklist checking and simpler template/rules checks.
organization_specific_finding: NYU is the hypothetical higher-education setting. Approved environment, permitted documents and staff authority are supplied assumptions, not verified institutional policy. Local comparative performance is unknown; pilot owner, budget and protocol require confirmation. Representative tests must meet agreed quality and net time-saving targets versus manual review, retaining review and rollback. Enjoyment, vendor growth, unverified extra flags and sunk effort do not establish benefit. Passing supports bounded staged expansion, not universal adoption. No completed pilot is asserted; the stated result is a conditional evidence standard, not an observed outcome.

evidence.claim: Approved environment, permitted documents, staff approval, leading-edge assumption and absent local comparative evidence.
evidence.source_or_reference: source_questions.txt; Questions for your agents.pdf, case slides 01/12 and 02/12
evidence.date_or_recency: Undated classroom PDF supplied and read 2026-11-03
evidence.notes: No verified actual NYU conditions, current market assessment or measured outcomes.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Advocate: bounded learning may reduce review burden sooner. Risk officer: missed requirements and checking burden may erase benefit; staff oversight must be tested, not presumed effective.
Novelty, vendor popularity, sunk effort and excessive caution cannot substitute for application evidence.
General maturity is assumed by the question, not independently verified.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence in the case-based distinction and bounded direction; low confidence in actual deployment readiness. No local results or approved numerical targets are provided.
value_opportunity_implication: Potentially reduce total administrative effort while preserving checklist quality; savings remain a hypothesis. Compare manual review and template/rules alternatives including setup and checking burden.
risk_governance_implication: Staff retain final approval. No automatic compliance certification. Confirm operating owner and meaningful review; pass training, workflow capacity, incentives, feedback and readiness assessment to Organizational Adoption.
recommendation_management_implication: BOUNDED_EXPERIMENT: Propose a supervised four-week shadow pilot, conditional on a named program-review lead and approved budget before execution. Use only permitted syllabi in the approved environment; no automatic syllabus approval. Proposed sample: 30 representative syllabi stratified by program and complexity, including missing/ambiguous elements, with an independently adjudicated checklist reference. Compare matched AI-assisted and manual reviews, plus a template/rules baseline where feasible. Count review, correction and setup time; evaluate required-element recall, false positives and passage correctness. Proposed gates, requiring staff approval before testing: no missed critical required elements, at least manual-baseline quality, and at least 20% lower median total staff effort. Proposed cap: 40 staff-hours; money budget must be approved separately. Stop for a critical missed requirement, fabricated supporting passage, unauthorized data, ineffective review, or forecast cap breach. Review at week four: failure means pause and DEFER pending repair; no advantage means reconsider or REJECT_FOR_PRESENT the current design; passing supports only a separately approved staged expansion. Strongest driver: reversible local comparative learning; loss of permission or effective review reverses this posture.
change_monitoring_triggers: At week four review representative quality and total-time results against pre-agreed manual-baseline targets.
Pause for a critical miss, unsupported passage, unauthorized data, ineffective review or cap breach; independently review repair before retesting.
Only verified representative quality and net-time advantage with retained review/rollback supports considering a separately authorized staged expansion.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Confirm accountable pilot lead, budget, agreed quality targets and sample coverage before execution.
No university-wide adoption judgment or actual NYU compliance conclusion is supported.
